verdict: No paid ads running; your Google Business Profile is holding steady.
narrative: No paid advertising ran this period — zero spend on Meta or Google — so no paid leads were generated. Your Google Business Profile carried all engagement this period, with 45 total actions (2 calls, 35 directions, 8 website clicks) across 28 days. GBP actions dipped 14% compared to the prior week, though at this volume that reflects normal organic variation rather than a trend. Organic search brought 44 clicks and 180 website sessions, but none converted to a tracked lead action — a gap we're looking at closely. Paid campaigns resuming would be the fastest path to measurable lead flow.
